subject: Annual prepay bridge & VAT recovery onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Russo <elena.russo@neptunehealth.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@neptunehealth.io
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: annual prepay bridge + VAT recovery process

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Neptune Health is ready to move to an annual prepay structure for 2028, but we have two sticking points from our finance and tax teams: 1) a short lead-time bridge for July–Aug while our remittance runs through our treasury onboarding, and 2) documentation to support monthly VAT reclaim for our EU entities (they need invoice-level VAT evidence for audits).

Can you send a proposed drawdown schedule (monthly vs quarterly windows), an options note for a short escrow buffer during the bridge period, and a checklist of the invoice fields your billing team includes (VAT amount, seller VAT id, entity line-by-line)? We also attached our internal commitment matrix for your reference (attached).

Happy to hop on a quick call if needed — finance prefers confirmation by COB next week (Friday).

Thanks,
Elena Russo
Head of Finance Operations
Neptune Health
Attachment: initial_commitment_schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@neptunehealth.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: annual prepay bridge + VAT recovery process

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the schedule. High level proposal below (I kept things conservative given the audit requirement):

- Drawdown cadence: monthly as default (first business day) with optional quarter-bucketing if you prefer consolidated invoices.
- Bridge option: one-time July tranche held in a short-term escrow (client-controlled) — 10% buffer of the monthly burn to cover spikes while treasury onboarding finishes. Release policy defined in Section 3 of the attached template.
- VAT evidence: we include seller VAT ID, per-invoice VAT line by billed entity, net/gross/tokenized metering lines, and a PDF invoice per drawdown. For reverse-charge cases we flag the line and include the supplier declaration field.

I attached our prepay template that shows the invoice layout and suggested remittance instructions you can share with your bank. If that looks good I can send a DocuSign for the MA amendment and loop our billing ops to provision the prepay ledger.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm monthly drawdown + 10% escrow buffer (yes/no)
2) Reply with the billing remittance details (account name, IBAN, SWIFT) or indicate if you want us to hold escrow instead of direct remits
3) If approved, we’ll schedule a 30-min ops call with Kimberly and Jonas to coordinate VAT evidence format and matching to your PO fields.

Attachment: redwood_prepay_template.csv (CSV, 12KB)

—
Marcus Lin
Head of Customer Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@neptunehealth.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: annual prepay bridge + VAT recovery process

Thanks Marcus / Elena — a few clarifying items from a VAT and invoicing perspective so we can avoid chase notes during monthly reclaim: 

- Please confirm the legal entity that will be invoiced (full legal name and VAT number). We need entity-level matches for our invoices and for your accounting team to reclaim.
- For EU reclaim: confirm whether Neptune will be using reverse-charge or claiming supplier VAT. If reverse-charge, confirm the local registration number and whether you need a zero-rated invoice line or a flagged note on each invoice.
- PO / invoice matching: include the PO number on the invoice header and as a per-line reference if you need line-level match. If you have multiple POs per month, tell us the preferred aggregation (one invoice per PO or consolidated).
- Escrow vs direct remits: if you choose escrow, we’ll generate an escrow account statement each drawdown and a short release manifest. This helps with audit trails but adds one day to the liquidity window.

If you share a sample VAT reclaim case (one historic invoice + reclaim result) we can map our CSV fields to your invoice evidence today and avoid surprises.

I’ve included the fields we require on Redwood invoices in the attached checklist. Once we have the legal entity and PO preferences I’ll create the final invoice template and expedite the MA amendment to legal.

—
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: invoice_field_checklist.pdf (PDF, 24KB)
From: Elena Russo <elena.russo@neptunehealth.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@neptunehealth.io
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 14:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Request: annual prepay bridge + VAT recovery process

Hi Kimberly / Marcus —

Thanks for the fast follow-ups. Quick answers from our tax/treasury: 
- Invoiced entity: Neptune Health B.V., VAT NL123456789 (we are the reclaiming entity).
- VAT approach: supplier VAT claim (we will submit supplier VAT reclaim monthly). We need a full VAT line and seller VAT ID on each invoice; no reverse-charge flag required for this country.
- PO prefs: we prefer one consolidated invoice per calendar month with PO code NH-PO-2028-07 included on the header and each line.
- Escrow: we accept the 10% escrow buffer for July only to cover the bridge; thereafter direct remits monthly. Please route the escrow to a client-controlled account with a release manifest.

I attached the signed MA amendment and bank wire instructions for our treasury team. We should be able to confirm remittance details by Monday.

Attachments: signed_ma.pdf (PDF, 128KB); bank_wire_instructions.pdf (PDF, 16KB)

Best,
Elena
Elena Russo
Head of Finance Operations, Neptune Health

Elena —

Received the signed MA and wire instructions, thanks. We will: 
1) Create the consolidated monthly invoice template with VAT line and seller VAT ID for Neptune Health B.V.
2) Provision a one-time July escrow ledger capped at 10% of the monthly average (per the template) and publish the release manifest at the first drawdown.
3) Loop billing ops to expect direct remits starting August 1 and flag the July escrow release once treasury confirms receipt.

I’ll post the final invoice sample and the DocuSign link for the MA amendment to the HubSpot record by COB Monday.

—
Jonas Weber
